page.overview:
Who is Doctor Bonham?

He examines Jamie when she is brought to the hospital and finds placental fluid, estimating that she gave birth no less than twenty-four hours before she was killed. This enables Sam Loomis to ascertain where the baby is. He is later revealed to be a member of the Cult of Thorn and about to assist in an operation on a subject before he is killed by Michael Myers.

Similar to the theatrical version, he examines Jamie, who was alive when she was brought to the hospital, and reveals to Loomis that during Jamie's surgery, she was hemorrhaging, in addition to finding the placental fluid, revealing that she was pregnant twenty-four hours earlier before she was found stabbed. He was later seen part of the ceremony in Smith's Grove Sanitarium where the Cult of Thorn were going to witness Michael kill Steven as his final sacrifice, and Danny kill Kara as his first, before Tommy intervened and rescued them.
